item.title: Julio Iglesias accused of sexual assault in Caribbean as Spanish prosecutors study allegations
item.description: Spanish prosecutors are studying allegations that Grammy-winning singer Julio Iglesias sexually assaulted two former employees.

item.title: Iran signals fast trials and executions for protesters as death toll in crackdown goes over 2,500
item.description: The head of Iran's judiciary signaled there would be fast trials and executions ahead for those detained in nationwide protests despite a warning from President Trump.

item.title: Bay Area could lose billions if Trump cuts funding to sanctuary cities; AG Bonta says it's unlawful
item.description: Trump says that starting February 1, sanctuary cities and states will lose all federal funding. In San Francisco alone, this would mean the loss of hundreds of millions of dollars, but the city has already sued and won on this issue.

item.title: Maury Povich reflects on daytime television's wild ride in 'Dirty Talk'
item.description: The new docuseries "Dirty Talk: When Daytime Talk Shows Ruled TV" takes us behind the scenes of some of the most sensational shows that shaped pop culture.

item.title: Reservations not required to visit Yosemite National Park to see 'firefall' phenomenon
item.description: A rare phenomenon draws crowds to Yosemite National Park each February, and this year, reservations will not be required during these peak visit times.

item.title: Some personnel at key US base in Qatar advised to evacuate as Iran official brings up earlier attack
item.description: Some personnel at a key U.S. military base in Qatar have been advised to evacuate by Wednesday evening. The decision came as a senior official in Iran brought up an earlier Iranian attack there.

item.title: Louisiana seeks extradition of Bay Area doctor accused of mailing abortion pills
item.description: A Sonoma County doctor has been charged with a felony in Louisiana for mailing abortion pills to a resident there. The indictment, followed by a request to extradite the doctor, is an escalation of Louisiana's efforts to counter states that support providing abortions.

item.title: ICE agent who shot Renee Good suffered internal bleeding, officials say
item.description: The ICE agent who shot Renee Good in the alleged car-ramming incident suffered internal bleeding, multiple U.S. officials told ABC News.

item.title: BART service restored between Concord and Orinda after power issue causes major delays
item.description: BART service has been restored Wednesday morning on the Yellow line after a shutdown between Concord and Orinda in the East Bay due to a trackside power issue.

item.title: Verizon 'aware' of service issues, working to restore connectivity as thousands report outage
item.description: Verizon is responding Wednesday to an issue impacting wireless voice and data service for some customers, the company said.
